name: sotto
description: A silent copilot for Google Meet. Reads your own Meet captions and shared screen through a local Chrome extension and gives you private cues in text: what to ask, what to expect, and context from your work.

interface.shortDescription: A silent copilot for your Google Meet calls.
interface.longDescription: Sotto reads your own Google Meet tab (live captions and the shared screen) through a local Chrome extension and gives you short, private cues while the meeting happens: what to ask, what to expect, and context from your work. Nothing joins the call.
defaultPrompt: Listen to my Google Meet and give me cues
Help me in this vendor call: push for a pilot
